description: A student team of about 50 that designs and builds levitating high-speed vehicles and competes at European Hyperloop Week. I went from sponsorship agent to team lead.

roles.what: Led 48 people to build and test a 250 kg levitating vehicle; ran recruitment, goals and budget.
Grew funding 42% (64k€ to 91k€) and in-kind support 60%; presented the Unveiling to 400 people.
Negotiated sponsorships and represented the team at public events.
